messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "move_appointment without stating the new slot and getting explicit confirmation.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant failed to obtain explicit confirmation from the patient before moving the appointment. The policy explicitly requires stating the details and obtaining confirmation ('yes'/'да') from the patient before proceeding with the move_appointment action (q14)."}}
